interval_years.quote: receive thereafter the current annual registration certificate authorizing him or her to continue the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene in the state for a period of one year

required.quote: The successful completion of continuing education program requirements shall be a requisite for renewal of licenses and permits issued pursuant to this chapter.

available.quote: Licensure by credentials may be utilized to evaluate the theoretical knowledge and clinical skill of a dentist or dental hygienist when an applicant for licensure by credentials holds a dental or dental hygiene license in another state.

requirements.value: Active practice for 5 years or 5,000 hours; current valid unrevoked license in a state with equivalent examination standards; in good standing without restrictions; not subject to pending disciplinary action; passes jurisprudence exam; and meets other board criteria.
requirements.quote: Has been engaged in the active practice of clinical dentistry or clinical dental hygiene or in full-time dental or dental hygiene education for the five years or 5,000 hours immediately preceding his or her application.

exists.quote: there is hereby created the board. The board is hereby vested with the authority to carry out the purposes and enforce the provisions of this chapter. The board shall consist of six dentists

national_association.value: American Dental Association Commission on Dental Accreditation
national_association.quote: accredited by the American Dental Association Commission on Dental Accreditation and approved by the board

regulatory_model.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to practice dentistry in the State of Alabama except the following:

credential_type.quote: LICENSE. The grant of authority by the board to an individual to engage in the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene.

is_mandatory.quote: Any individual who engages in the practice of dentistry in this state within the meaning of this chapter without having first obtained from the board a license to practice dentistry shall be guilty of a Class C felony

title_protection.quote: Uses the words "dentist," "dental surgeon," "oral surgeon," or the letters "D.D.S.," "D.M.D." or any other words, letters, title, or descriptive matter which in any way represents him or her as being able to diagnose, treat, prescribe, or operate for any disease, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury, or physical condition of the teeth or jaws, or adjacent structures.

scope_protection.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to practice dentistry in the State of Alabama except the following:

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation in obtaining a license, registration certificate, money, or other thing of value.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation in obtaining any license, license certificate, annual registration certificate, money, or other thing of value.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being a menace to public health or to patients or others by reason of a disease.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is a menace to the public health or to patients or others by reason of a disease.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual use of intoxicants or drugs rendering the licensee unfit to practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is an habitual user of intoxicants or drugs rendering him or her unfit for the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction for violation of federal or state narcotics or barbiturate laws.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted for violation of federal or state narcotics or barbiturate laws.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Negligence or gross negligence in the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of negligence or gross negligence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing, allowing, or permitting unlicensed persons to perform work that legally requires a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of employing, allowing, or permitting any unlicensed person or persons to perform any work in his or her office which, under this chapter, can only be legally done by a person or persons holding a license to practice dentistry or dental hygiene.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or negligently violating sanitation rules of the State Department of Health or the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully or negligently violates the rules of the State Department of Health or of the board regarding sanitation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Division of fees or fee-splitting with any person for bringing or referring a patient without the patient's knowledge.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of division of fees, or agreeing to split or divide the fee received for dental service with any person for bringing or referring a patient without the knowledge of the patient or his or her legal representative

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional connection or association with anyone engaged in the illegal practice of dentistry or dental hygiene.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of professional connection or association with or lending his or her name to anyone who is engaged in the illegal practice of dentistry or dental hygiene.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction in a court of competent jurisdiction of a felony or a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction in any court of competent jurisdiction of a felony or a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, administering, or dispensing controlled substances for any person not under the dentist's treatment or for non-dentally related conditions.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the prescribing, administering or dispensing of any controlled substances enumerated in Schedules I through V contained in the Alabama Uniform Controlled Substances Act... for any person not under his or her treatment in the regular practice of his or her profession.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Irregularities in billing an insurance company or other third-party payer for services rendered.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Irregularities in billing an insurance company or other third party payer for services rendered to a patient.
Pertaining to licensed dentists only, patient abandonment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any rule adopted by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any rule adopted by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license or permit to practice dentistry or dental hygiene from another state suspended or revoked based on acts similar to those described in the disciplinary grounds.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had his or her license or permit to practice dentistry or dental hygiene from another state suspended or revoked based upon acts similar to those described in this section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of the dental practice act chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision of this chapter.

insurance_required.quote: proof of insurance from a licensed insurance carrier that the operator has in force at least one million dollars ($1,000,000) of general liability insurance.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: The mobile dental facility or a portable dental operation shall be inspected by the board or its representative prior to receiving a certificate of registration. Once registered, the mobile dental facility or a portable dental operation shall be subject to periodic unannounced audits and inspections by the board.

definition_quote.value: Any person shall be deemed to be practicing dentistry who does any of the following: (1) Performs, or attempts or professes to perform, any dental operation or dental service of any kind...
definition_quote.quote: Any person shall be deemed to be practicing dentistry who does any of the following:

value: impressions of human teeth, jaws, or adjacent tissue
prosthetic and appliance construction, repair, reproduction
diagnosis and treatment of dental disease, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury
removal of tumors, abnormal growths, or lesions from gums, jaws, and adjacent structures
surgical or mechanical treatment of jaw fractures
administration of local and general anesthetics
methods_authorized.quote: who extracts or attempts to extract human teeth, or removes tumors, abnormal growths, or other lesions from the human gums, jaws, and adjacent structures, or who operates for cleft lip or palate, or both; or who treats surgically or mechanically fractures of the human jaw; or who administers local or general anesthetics in the treatment of any dental lesion.

drug_authority.value: Licensed dentists are authorized to administer local anesthesia; may obtain permits to use general anesthesia, parenteral sedation, and oral conscious sedation. May prescribe, administer, and dispense controlled substances for dentally or facially related conditions and necessary medications during treatment. Dental hygienists may administer infiltration anesthesia under direct supervision with a permit.
drug_authority.quote: All dentists are authorized to use local anesthesia.

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: no dentist shall use general anesthesia on an outpatient basis for dental patients, unless the dentist possesses a permit of authorization issued by the board.

sedation_permit_onsite_inspection_requir.quote: Prior to the issuance of the permit, the board, at its discretion, may require an on-site inspection of the facility, equipment, and personnel to determine if the requirements in paragraph a. have been met.

sedation_adverse_event_reporting_require.quote: All licensees engaged in the practice of dentistry in the state must submit a complete report within a period of 30 days to the Board of Dental Examiners of any mortality or other incident occurring in the outpatient facilities of such dentist which results in permanent physical or mental injury of the patient as a direct result of general anesthesia or sedation techniques.

pediatric_sedation_endorsement_required.quote: When oral conscious sedation is used on any patient under 12 years of age, the following provisions shall apply: (1) The drugs, dosages, and techniques used should carry a margin of safety which is unlikely to render the patient noninteractive and nonarousable. (2) Appropriately sized emergency equipment must be available.

specialist_license_available.quote: A dentist may not hold himself or herself out as a specialist or advertise specialty status unless the specialty is approved by the board.

specialty_practice_scope_restriction.quote: An applicant who chooses to announce or practice a specialty shall limit his or her practice exclusively to the announced special area or areas of dental practice.

specialty_advertising_disclaimer_require.quote: a dentist who lacks membership in or certification, diplomate status, or other similar credentials from an accrediting organization approved as bona fide by the board may announce a practice emphasis in any other area of dental practice if the dentist incorporates in capital letters or some other manner clearly distinguishable from the rest of the announcement, solicitation, or advertisement the following statement: "_____________ (NAME OF ANNOUNCED AREA OF DENTAL PRACTICE) IS NOT RECOGNIZED AS A SPECIALTY AREA BY THE BOARD OF DENTAL EXAMINERS OF ALABAMA."

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: A dental hygienist shall work only under the direct supervision of a licensed dentist practicing in this state.

mobile_dental_facility_registration_requ.quote: In order to operate a mobile dental facility or portable dental operation, an operator shall first obtain a certificate of registration issued by the board.

mobile_facility_followup_care_protocol_r.quote: The operator shall maintain a written procedure for emergency follow-up care for patients treated in a mobile dental facility

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: Every duly licensed and registered dentist who employs the services of a commercial dental laboratory or private technician for the purpose of constructing, altering, repairing, or duplicating any prostheses (fixed or removable), splint, or orthodontic appliance shall be required to furnish the commercial dental laboratory or private technician an impression or cast made by the dentist when necessary, together with a prescription

teledentistry_authorized.quote: The rendering of a written or otherwise documented professional opinion concerning the diagnosis or treatment of a patient located within this state by a dentist located outside this state as a result of transmission of individual patient data by electronic or other means from within this state to the dentist or his or her agent.

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: In order to administer infiltration anesthesia, a dental hygienist shall possess a dental hygiene infiltration anesthesia permit issued by the board.

patient_record_retention_years.quote: The duplicate copy shall be retained in a permanent file for a period of two years by the dentist, and the original copy shall be retained on a permanent file for a period of two years by the commercial dental laboratory or private technician.

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: Any dentist using general anesthesia, and his or her auxiliary personnel shall be currently certified in cardiopulmonary resuscitation.

dental_hygienist_alternative_practice_li.quote: A dental hygienist shall work only under the direct supervision of a licensed dentist practicing in this state.

scope__sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: In order to administer oral conscious sedation, a dentist must possess a general anesthesia permit, a parenteral sedation permit, or an oral conscious sedation permit from the board.
No dentist shall use parenteral sedation on an outpatient basis for dental patients unless the dentist possesses a permit of authorization issued by the board.
no dentist shall use general anesthesia on an outpatient basis for dental patients, unless the dentist possesses a permit of authorization issued by the board.

scope__sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.item: Pediatric General Anesthesia / Deep Sedation Endorsement

scope__sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: In order to administer infiltration anesthesia, a dental hygienist shall possess a dental hygiene infiltration anesthesia permit issued by the board.

scope__dental_hygienist_supervision_leve.quote: A dental hygienist shall work only under the direct supervision of a licensed dentist practicing in this state.

scope__dental_hygienist_supervision_leve.item: Advanced practice / collaborative practice (no supervising dentist required)
